title: Vertex through the OpenAgents cloud as the no-setup fallback provider
body:
Owner (2026-09-28): Vertex must go through **our cloud service**. No one should ever have to supply a Vertex token. It's the fallback when a user has nothing else configured (no Claude Code, Codex, Devin, or OpenCode with capacity).

#9891 (f3d4f0dc3a) added Vertex as a third provider in Microcoder's capacity book, but it expects a Vertex token on the host and a NEEDS_OWNER step to add one. Replace that:

- The Vertex route calls the OpenAgents cloud (the existing Worker/gateway, or whatever serving path #9914 chooses for the conversation-first basic chat — share it), authenticated by the device/host identity the user already has, with per-user quotas and abuse limits server-side. No Google credentials on any user machine or in any app.
- It is the default fallback when nothing else is configured or has capacity, including on a fresh host with no provider CLIs logged in.
- Remove the Vertex-token owner step from the workspace NEEDS_OWNER.md and any token-reading code path on hosts.
- Record the invariant (no provider token on user machines for the cloud fallback) in INVARIANTS.md with tests.

Acceptance: a host with no provider configured completes a Coder task through the cloud fallback; quota refusal is typed and fails over or reports plainly; tests; docs in docs/coder/.
